title: guatteria neglecta
intro: Guatteria neglecta, commonly known as the "Neglected Guatteria," is a plant species belonging to the Annonaceae family. This plant is valued for its medicinal properties, which include reducing inflammation, fighting off bacteria, and soothing respiratory issues. The health benefits of Guatteria neglecta include its ability to alleviate fever, treat coughs, and help with the management of digestive problems. Its therapeutic actions are attributed to its bioactive constituents, which include alkaloids, terpenoids, and flavonoids, although further research is required to fully understand its potential uses and applications.
